Hughes County Office Hours Excluding Major Holidays:
Clerk of Courts
The Clerk's Office is part of the JUDICIAL system and NOT part of COUNTY government. Their office can be reached at 605 773 3713 EXT 8
States Attorney
The States Attorney does NOT represent or assist private citizens with private civil matters.
Provides criminal prosecution, oversees juvenile delinquency, abuse and neglect, as well as protects children and vulnerable adults in the county.
They also provide legal counsel for the county, and review law enforcement reports.
Their office hours are 8 to 5 Monday through Friday.
605 773 7462
Treasurer
Please call for assistance with vehicle tags and paying taxes.
Office hours are 8 to 4:30 Monday through Friday
Titles are not processed after 4:15 PM
605 773 7491
Auditor
Please call for assistance with elections and passports.
Office hours are 8 to 4:30 Monday through Friday
605 773 7451
Register of Deeds
Please call for assistance with vital records and recording documents.
Office hours are 8 to 4:30 Monday through Friday
605 773 7495
Equalization
Please call for assistance with tax information, tax program eligibility.
Office hours are 8 to 4:30 Monday through Friday
605 773 7483
Veteran Service Office
Please call for assistance with veteran service programs.
Office hours are 7:30 to 4:30 Monday through Friday; except for travel and programming days
605 773 6975
Planning Office
Please call for assistance with ordinances, zoning and obtaining a rural address.
Office hours are 8 to 4:30 Monday through Friday
605 773 7441
These offices provide more assistance than what is listed, however this is to assist you in getting started with your questions.
Hughes
County Burn Bans
Hughes County relies
on an automated burn ban triggered by the weather. Outdoor burning is strictly
prohibited autonomously whenever the National Weather Service issues a Red
Flag Warning or when the South
Dakota Grassland Fire Danger Index reaches Very High
or Extreme . You must notify county dispatch or local fire authorities
before conducting any large controlled burns on rural property.
Click the link to
view the warning in your county: https://www.weather.gov/unr/rfd
ps://www.weather.gov/unr/rfd
